title: Online Refund/Refund Authorization
applicability: Applies to Merchandise Return (also called credit voucher/purchase return; Transaction Type 7) processing and the Online Refund/Refund Authorization Indicator carried in POS Additional Data Information (Table ID 32, Segment 111, Sub-Table 11) for participating merchants and subsequent reversals/follow-ups/Timeout Reversals.
source: specifications/ATL105/docs/specs/extracted_text.txt Appendix X-1 and Appendix I-27 (Table ID 32, Sub-Table 11)

businessRequirements.title: A participating merchant requesting online authorization for a Merchandise Return (Transaction Type 7) must send the indicator in Table 32 Sub-Table 11; a merchant not wanting online approval must not send it.
The indicator is carried as Table 32 Sub-Table 11 with fixed Sub-Table ID 11, fixed length 001, and valid code Y; Appendix X names Visa, MasterCard, Amex, and Discover.
When the indicator is included on a Merchandise Return, carry it into subsequent reversal/follow-up transactions and Timeout Reversals.
Online Refund/Refund Authorization availability is merchant-specific and must be confirmed with the First Data representative.

The historical Visa rollout described different dates for certain previously notified merchants and all other merchants; current merchant applicability is not derivable without cohort/configuration evidence.
The online authorization is described as a real-time pending-refund notification to the issuer and/or cardholder; delivery behavior is outside the indicator field and requires external evidence.

Expected decline conditions include issuer unavailability or an invalid account, but issuers retain discretion to decline for any reason; do not encode a closed decline-reason allowlist from Appendix X.

For applicable Visa merchants, the real-time online authorization must precede the existing Settlement System Refund; applicability depends on merchant cohort/configuration and is review-gated unless supplied.
